FAQ

Have questions?
We're here to help

After a quick online assessment, a licensed EVLV provider reviews your goals and health history, then builds a personalized plan. Approved treatments are compounded in our U.S. pharmacy and shipped to your door, with ongoing provider access and automatic refills.

EVLV is a cash-pay telehealth service, so we don't bill insurance directly. Our pricing is transparent and membership-based, with no copays or surprise fees - you'll always see the full cost before you start.

Yes. Most EVLV treatments and lab work are eligible HSA/FSA expenses. We'll provide an itemized receipt you can submit for reimbursement through your plan administrator.

At this time EVLV only treats and ships to patients within the United States. You must have a valid U.S. shipping address and be physically located in a state where our providers are licensed.

You can complete recommended lab work at any of 2,000+ LabCorp or Quest locations. Results flow directly into your EVLV portal, where your provider explains what they mean and adjusts your plan accordingly.

Our support team is quick, human, and happy to help. Reach out anytime through your EVLV portal or at support@EVLVmd.com and we'll get back to you fast.

By providing it and continuing, you agree that EVLV may send you text messages to verify your phone and for any lawful purposes related to your EVLV account, such as order confirmations, shipping updates, and messages from your provider.
